include_rule: Binary or multiclass focal liver-lesion classification
Human-only research with no animal subjects, animal imaging/data or animal experiments in study development or evaluation
exclude_rule: Any animal research component, including mixed human-animal studies even if human results are separable; phantom or simulation-only exclusion remains proposed
rationale: User strengthened animal exclusion on 2026-11-22; incidental background citations alone do not constitute animal research

include_rule: At least one evaluated multiphase CT classification approach; retain single-phase comparator arms
exclude_rule: Standalone single-phase-only studies provisionally outside main corpus
rationale: Multiphase focus confirmed; standalone single-phase boundary unresolved

include_rule: Radiomics, CT feature-based machine learning, deep learning, or implemented agentic/multi-agent workflows with evaluated focal liver-lesion classification
exclude_rule: No evaluated computational lesion classification; generic agents or unrelated agent tasks
rationale: User requested agentic and multi-agent coverage within the same CT classification scope

include_rule: Detection or segmentation pipeline with separately reported eligible classification results
exclude_rule: Detection/segmentation only; prognosis, recurrence or MVI prediction only

include_rule: CT-only imaging inputs for eligible classification results; separately evaluated CT-only arms may be retained; clinical-covariate policy remains proposed
exclude_rule: Results requiring MRI, ultrasound, PET or other non-CT imaging; no separable CT-only evaluation
rationale: User explicitly confirmed CT-only imaging on 2026-11-22

include_rule: Any relevant binary/multiclass lesion labels; chart relation to HH/HCC/ICC/LM
exclude_rule: No diagnostic lesion identity or benign/malignant classification
rationale: Do not require all four project classes

include_rule: Peer-reviewed original research in full journal or conference papers; dataset reports require eligible original classification evaluation
exclude_rule: All review articles and meta-analyses; editorials, guidance, clinical summaries and protocols without original results
rationale: User confirmed original research only; reviews may inform background/citation searching but are not included evidence

include_rule: Verified peer-reviewed full publication meeting all other criteria; assess published version where a preprint also exists
exclude_rule: Preprints, non-peer-reviewed reports and abstract-only conference records
rationale: User requires peer-reviewed research; confirm status from journal/proceedings rather than indexing alone

include_rule: English-language full reports published within the three years preceding the initial formal search date, inclusive; if searched 2026-11-22: 2023-11-22 to 2026-11-22
exclude_rule: Reports outside the date window or without an English full report; English abstract alone insufficient
rationale: User-selected scope restriction on 2026-11-22; rolling-window interpretation documented in protocol

include_rule: Any country or clinical setting; retrospective/prospective and public datasets
Link companion reports and overlapping cohorts; retain distinct relevant information
exclude_rule: Duplicate records removed; reports not counted as independent studies automatically
